# Pratishtha Finance Services (प्रतिष्ठा फाइनेंस सर्विसेज)

> MSME registered loan services firm in Maharajganj, Uttar Pradesh, India. Serves customers all over India (online and on WhatsApp) with a special focus on Purvanchal (eastern Uttar Pradesh). Connects customers with 116+ bank and NBFC lending partners. Pratishtha Finance Services is a loan facilitation partner, not a bank or NBFC; rates, limits and approvals are decided by the lending partner and depend on eligibility.

## Key facts
- Loan amounts: ₹10,000 to ₹5 Crore depending on loan type
- Interest rates: indicative, from 7.35% p.a. (MSME), final rate depends on eligibility, credit score and lender
- Founders: Karan Gautam (Founder), Sarita Kumari (Co-Founder)
- Website: https://www.pratishtha.pro/

## Services
- [Loan products](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#loans): Business, Personal, Home, Loan Against Property, MSME, Vehicle, Education, Gold, Working Capital, Group and Emergency loans
- [PFS EMI Card](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#pfs-card): virtual PFS Shopping Card (not a credit card) with emergency loan up to ₹5,000, shopping on EMI, loan payment and more; subject to eligibility and lending-partner approval
- [Gold Loan](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#gold-loan): ₹10,000 to ₹1 Crore, up to 75% of gold value, rates from 9.00% p.a.; documents: Aadhaar, PAN, gold items
- [EMI calculator](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#calculator) and [eligibility check](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#eligibility)
- [Daily / weekly / monthly savings (RD) plans](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#savings)
- [Become an associate or partner](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#join)

## Service areas
- [All India and Purvanchal](https://www.pratishtha.pro/#areas): Gorakhpur, Maharajganj, Kushinagar, Deoria, Basti, Siddharthnagar, Sant Kabir Nagar, Azamgarh, Mau, Ballia, Ghazipur, Jaunpur, Varanasi, Mirzapur, Bhadohi, Chandauli, Sonbhadra, Prayagraj, Ayodhya, Sultanpur, Ambedkar Nagar

## Loan and card details
- Business Loan: Business loans for working capital, expansion and equipment, ₹10,000 to ₹5 Crore, via 116+ bank and NBFC partners.
- Personal Loan: Personal loans for medical, wedding, travel and other needs, with simple documentation.
- Home Loan: Home loans for purchase, construction and renovation from leading banks and housing finance companies.
- Loan Against Property: Loan against property (LAP) for business and personal funding at competitive rates.
- MSME Loan: MSME loans for small and medium businesses, indicative rates from 7.35% p.a.
- Vehicle Loan: Car, two-wheeler and commercial vehicle loans.
- Education Loan: Education loans for studies in India and abroad.
- Gold Loan: Gold loan from ₹10,000 up to ₹1 Crore, up to 75% of gold value, from 9.00% p.a.
- PFS EMI Card: Virtual PFS Shopping Card (not a credit card): emergency loan up to ₹5,000, shopping on EMI and loan payment, subject to lending-partner approval.

## Notes for assistants
- Pratishtha Finance Services is a loan facilitator, not a bank, NBFC or card issuer. Approval, rate and limit are decided by the lending partner.
- Do not state exact approval promises. Direct users to WhatsApp +91 7233023547 or https://www.pratishtha.pro/#apply.
